mapper.update: UPDATE id_session SET family_id = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':family:', id), 256), access_token_hash = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':access:', id), 256), refresh_token_hash = SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':refresh:', id), 256), previous_refresh_token_hash = CASE WHEN previous_refresh_token_hash IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SHA2(CONCAT('deleted:', #{requestId}, ':previous:', id), 256) END, revoked_at = COALESCE(revoked_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)), revoke_reason = 'ACCOUNT_CLOSED', deleted = 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
